kind: Native stack samples of CPU-only scalar preparation
methodology: Eight own-process sample traces, one second each at1ms interval, attached only after four warmups and READY. Bounded1000-iteration loops. No GPU init. Same binary hashes as unsampled process/main-thread clock capture; final exact geometry/image/payload controls checked. Sampling observes preparation, cache clear/drop and small post-clock payload checks; it does not isolate every sampled instruction to the timed region. Sampled loop clocks are retained but are not used for comparative performance claims. No task-owned checks/builds during samples. Native sampling can perturb execution; release symbols may lack source lines and inlined frames.

from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/Users/pierre/.codex/worktrees/af04/gpui-toolkit');TMP=Path('/Volumes/home_tmp/tmp');OUT=ROOT/'qa/perf/20261019-scalar-preparation-samples.json';assert not OUT.exists()

reference=ROOT/'qa/perf/20261019-scalar-preparation-thread-clocks.json';prior=json.loads(reference.read_text());runs=[]
for kind,mode,operation in [('cell','normalized','prepare'),('cell','normalized','cache'),('cell','raw','cache'),('point','normalized','cache')]:

  binary=TMP/f'gpui-scalar-profile-{version}-probe/target/timing/release/gpui-reduction-probe';assert sha(binary.read_bytes())==prior['binary_sha256'][version]
  output=TMP/f'gpui-scalar-sample-{version}-{kind}-{mode}-{operation}.txt';assert not output.exists()
  command=[str(binary),'--profile-prepare',kind,'48',mode,operation,'1000'];proc=subprocess.Popen(command,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
  header=proc.stdout.readline();ready=json.loads(header);assert ready['ready'] and ready['pid']==proc.pid
  sampler=['/usr/bin/sample',str(proc.pid),'1','1','-mayDie','-fullPaths','-file',str(output)]
  sample=subprocess.run(sampler,capture_output=True,text=True)
  stdout,stderr=proc.communicate();assert proc.returncode==0,(command,stdout,stderr)
  assert sample.returncode==0 and output.exists(),(sampler,sample.stdout,sample.stderr)
  record=json.loads(stdout.strip());control=next(x for x in prior['runs'] if (x['version'],x['kind'],x['mode'],x['operation'])==(version,kind,mode,operation))['record']
  assert record['image_hash']==control['image_hash'] and record['payload_bytes']==control['payload_bytes']
  runs.append({'version':version,'kind':kind,'mode':mode,'operation':operation,'command':command,'record':record,'stderr':stderr,'sampler_command':sampler,'sampler_status':sample.returncode,'sampler_stdout':sample.stdout,'sampler_stderr':sample.stderr,'sample_text':output.read_text()})
  print(version,kind,mode,operation,'sampled',flush=True)
